name: Benedict Dayton
source:
Dayton is the MC's personal butler. As per her parents' policy, he is here to serve her until she comes of age. His role is to serve her needs, ensure her well-being and protect her person.
He is newly graduated. he attended one of the best schools, "Highfields Academy of Service and Excellence", and earned his degree this spring just passed. As such, it's his first position as a butler.
